_comment: Ported from READERS in Parlour v23.dc.html (line ~1335). 'deck' names two starting cards resolved by name against cards_minor.json/cards_chroma.json at load time. Serpentarius (wild:true) has no fixed element — Rules.my_el() cycles it through the ring each reading (the 'serpent' fx).

readers.name: The Ram
readers.line: You put people in motion. That's the N°1 reason you have returning customers.
readers.rule: Fire restores +1, and your first card restores +2.

readers.name: The Bull
readers.line: You do not change the subject. People find it restful, and then unbearable.
readers.rule: Earth restores +1, chaining the same element restores +2.

readers.name: The Twins
readers.line: You can hold two stories at once. Nobody knows which one you hold dearest.

readers.name: The Crab
readers.line: You are sweet and a good listener. You are extra careful with your last say.
readers.rule: Water restores +1, and your last card restores +3.

readers.name: The Lion
readers.line: You can hold the room for as long as you want. You usually want.

readers.name: The Maiden
readers.line: You are more bottom-up than top-down. That means strong basics.
readers.rule: Earth restores +1, and the first two cards with no element restore +3.

readers.name: The Scales
readers.line: You never let them linger on something for too long. You might have trouble picking.
readers.rule: Air restores +1, and changing element restores +2.

readers.name: The Scorpion
readers.line: You can take it without flinching. That's the whole trick and it took years.
readers.rule: Water restores +1, first 4 cards pierce straight through their denial.
deck: Let Them Say The Worst Of It

readers.name: The Archer
readers.line: You have a tendency to make them overstay. Weirdly, the opposite never happens to you.
readers.rule: Fire restores +1, and every sitter stays one reading longer.

readers.name: The Goat
readers.line: You are eager to do the job and you do it well. The flaw is in the price.
readers.rule: Earth restores +1. Every sitter pays 5 centimes more.

readers.name: The Water Bearer
readers.line: You can go on and on once they get you started. Some call it stubbornness.
readers.rule: Air restores +1, and each air card restores +1 for every other air card.

readers.name: The Fishes
readers.line: You can feel it before they say it. You have learned to stop mentioning it.

readers.name: The Serpent Bearer
readers.line: You were never on the wheel. Nobody knows what you are and they come anyway.
readers.rule: Your element turns to the next one every reading, and whatever it is restores +3.
